verdict.rationale: Weave's own docs say you can evaluate responses 'using LLM judges and custom scorers'. A release note describes agent evaluations 'scored with an LLM judge', and scorers can be written as function-based or class-based (weave.Scorer) evaluators that return metric dictionaries. However, the evidence never shows how an LLM judge itself is configured (judge model choice, prompt/rubric template, scoring parameters), so configurability is only implied through custom scorer classes. Missing for 10: documented configuration options for LLM-judge scorers (model, prompt/rubric, output schema), a concrete built-in LLM-judge scorer reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can score outputs with configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators
